normalization: z-score using training-partition bouts only; validation/test use frozen training statistics
head_position_note: Raw head_pos-derived path features are excluded from the core confirmatory profile because coordinate discontinuities were observed during QC and source coordinate semantics are not fully resolved.
first_inter_bout_interval_rule: First valid bout for each fish receives inter_bout_interval_s = 0 because no preceding bout exists.
